name: Glute Bridge Walkout
instructions: Start in a glute bridge with hips fully extended.
Keeping the hips lifted, take small steps outward with alternating feet.
Walk out as far as you can while keeping the hips level — no sagging.
Walk the feet back in. The further you walk, the harder the hamstrings work.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: An intermediate bodyweight hinge-pattern exercise for the glutes. Glute Bridge Walkout builds posterior-chain strength that protects your back in everyday lifting.
